own_solution.law: Bernoulli between the reservoir surface and atmospheric outlet gives v² = 2gh. Uniform bore and continuity give the same speed at the crest. Thus pc = p0 - rho*g*(H+h) = 101.3 - 1000*9.8*2.3/1000 = 78.76 kPa.
assumptions: The large reservoir has negligible surface speed.
The stated steady, frictionless, incompressible flow fills the uniform tube.
The reservoir surface and outlet are at atmospheric pressure.
Pressure terms are converted to consistent units before addition.

T7E69.regime: Vapour pressure must remain below the minimum liquid pressure, 78.76 kPa at the crest; all listed values satisfy this.
